title: Starry Form: Chalice (Condition)
html:
Starry Form: Chalice

  • In Starry Form. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast  Chalice Healing.

 Polymorphed

Properties

 Stack ID: WILDSHAPE

 Status groups: SG_Polymorph, SG_RemoveOnRespec, SG_Light

Grants:

 Chalice Healing
Heal yourself or another creature within reach. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
 Dismiss Wild Shape
Dismiss your Wild Shape and change back to your original form.

Sources of Starry Form: Chalice

  • Starry Form: Chalice

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID WILDSHAPE, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Aberrant Shape
  • Your Intellect Devourer form has 21 Hit Points.
  • You gain the  Claws,  Devour Intellect, and  Synaptic Discharge abilities.
